problem: Rank real robot policies using generated video while avoiding expensive repeated physical trials.
contribution: WorldEval conditions WAN2.1 on latent features extracted before a policy action decoder (Policy2Vec), then uses Gemini video judging or FID for proxy evaluation. Goal is relative ranking, explicitly not exact behavioral reproduction.
algorithm: Capture policy latent embeddings with real initial frames/instructions; project and scale them into video-model language embeddings andLoRA-finetune14B WAN. Generate candidate policy videos and classify taskcompletion withGemini2.0. Each policy architecture needs a meaningful latent interface; latent intent alone need not identify the exact executed motor sequence.
observations: Top-cameraRGB, language and internal policy representations; target14Dstate/action data collected50Hz. Learned generated video omits nonvisual forces and can collapse on distribution shifts.
actions: Bimanual AgileX6DoF arms plus grippers represented14D. Policy2Vec is decoder-adjacent learned conditioning, not directURDFretargeting or a universal action vector; different checkpoints may shift latent semantics.
embodiment_and_data: ALOHA-style AgileX and reported RealSense457 topcamera.1400real training trajectories;WAN81frames480x480,30epochs,LoRArank/alpha16. Five task categories includingbussing,toycollection,cup,handover,strike;40rollouts/task and>1000realtrials total acrosspolicies. CollectToy is heldouttask/objectcondition.
experiments: CompareDP,OpenVLA,DexVLA,pi0 rankings to actualtests, three matchedRoboTwin tasks, Policy2Vec versusVQVAE/onehot, simple-taskFID and qualitativecollapsed-policy example. DirectSIMPLERcomparison was unavailable; a matchedRoboTwin real-to-sim adaptation is used instead.
baselines: VQVAE/onehot action encodings;RoboTwinreal-to-sim; fourpolicyfamilies. FID correlates less on complexbussing. Claimed safety detector rests on one qualitative hazardous-action/mosaic example, without sensitivity/specificity or counterexamples.

limitations: Policy representation compatibility and training-data leakage can affect rankings; only one hardwarefamily is quantitativelyestablished. FID is weak on complex tasks. Video collapse can indicate OODlatent input or model failure rather than physical danger; plausible generated video can still hide dangerous actions. Do not deploy it as a safety gate or replace independent collision/hold evidence.
